{{Quote|Sorry, sir. Just received word from the fleet. General T'Teknulp and his division didn't make it.''"<br />"''He&hellip;T'Teknulp&hellip;he was right behind me.''|Commander Cody and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />}}
'''T'Teknulp''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who fought in many perilous battles. When the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farquar III]] aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent its forces to destroy a [[droid factory]] on the world, giving T'Teknulp command of a [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. During the [[battle of Farquar III]], T'Teknulp and his division were en route to reinforce [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]] when they encountered enemy forces in planetary [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. T'Teknulp [[Death/Legends|did not survive]] the engagement, and Kenobi was forced to continue the battle unaided.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Kay Six to Tee Eight! Kay Six to Tee Eight!''"<br />"''Tee Eight here! Wild greeting! See you in minus five! Tee Eight out!''|Obi-Wan Kenobi and T'Teknulp use their code names during the battle of Farquar III|<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />}}
A [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]], T'Teknulp was one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] called to lead the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out<ref name="TLaLoOWK" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> T'Teknulp developed a reputation as a skilled [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] while serving in the Clone Wars, with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] having complete confidence in his abilities. By the [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] leading up to the [[battle of Farquar III]], he had been involved in many dangerous battles but had not once been injured.<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />

When the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farquar III]] aligned with the Separatists, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent its [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] to destroy a [[droid factory]] on the world, giving T'Teknulp command of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Division/Legends|division]]. During the battle, T'Teknulp's division was en route to reinforce Kenobi's [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]] when they encountered enemy forces in planetary [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. T'Teknulp assured Kenobi that he would be at his position within five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]; however, T'Teknulp and his division were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After Kenobi's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], arrived and destroyed a number of enemy [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that were harassing his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] of the 7th Sky Corps, [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], gave them the news of T'Teknulp's fate. Both Kenobi and Skywalker were stunned by the news, with Skywalker reacting with disbelief, stating that T'Teknulp had been just behind him. The two mourned the loss of yet another Jedi in the Clone Wars before they proceeded to attack the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory.<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />

==Personality and traits==
T'Teknulp was well respected during the Clone Wars, having been involved in many dangerous battles, but had not once been injured. Obi-Wan Kenobi regarded T'Teknulp as a skilled general, holding complete faith in the Chadra-Fan's ability to reinforce him during the battle of Farquar III despite having encountered enemy forces in planetary orbit. T'Teknulp was unsuccessful, however, as he was killed before reaching Kenobi. T'Teknulp was known by others to have a strangely jovial and high squeaky voice; Kenobi noted that he always sounded happy no matter the circumstances.<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />

==Behind the scenes==
T'Teknulp appeared in the [[2008]] young adult novel ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]]. He is never present but is spoken to over a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]].<ref name="TLaLoOWK" />
